full_prompt_en: A square pointillist-leaning oil landscape shows a stone cottage on a green coastal headland beneath a luminous turquoise sky. The cottage stands on the right, broad and pale gray with a warm russet roof, a chimney, and dark window openings. A low stone wall traces the edge of its raised plot. A dirt path begins at the lower center and curves leftward past the house, then continues toward a small group of orange-roofed buildings in the middle distance. At the far left, a narrow blue sea inlet and a tiny moored sailboat are visible beside the coast. A lone rounded tree punctuates the horizon near those houses. The grassy slope fills most of the lower half, painted in small overlapping strokes of emerald, olive, blue-green, ochre, and warm brown. Above, the sky is densely stippled in turquoise and pale cyan, with salmon-pink and golden cloud marks scattered across it. The horizon stays low enough for the enormous colored sky to create an airy opening over the compact house. The brushwork is broken and granular, allowing adjacent colors to vibrate without being blended smooth. Late warm light appears to come from the left, edging the roof and path in orange and soft gold while the wall and house face remain cooler violet-gray. The sea gives a calm horizontal counterweight to the diagonal path. No visible people or readable text appear. The overall composition leads from the textured foreground path to the stone cottage and distant water, balancing bright coastal air with dense tactile color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形偏点彩笔法的油画风景描绘一座石屋立在绿色海岬上，头顶是发亮的青绿天空。石屋位于右侧，宽阔浅灰墙面、暖赤褐屋顶、烟囱和深色窗洞清晰可见。一道低石墙沿抬高院地边缘延伸。土路从下方中央开始，弯向左侧经过房屋，再通向中景一小组橙顶建筑。最左侧，狭窄蓝色海湾和一艘微小停泊帆船出现在岸旁。一棵圆冠独树点在那些房屋附近的地平线上。草坡占据下半部大部分，由祖母绿、橄榄、蓝绿、赭色和暖棕的小型叠笔绘成。上方天空密布青绿与浅青色点笔，散有鲑粉与金色云痕。地平线足够低，让巨大的彩色天空在紧凑石屋上方形成通透开口。笔触破碎而有颗粒，让相邻色彩互相振动而非被平滑混合。傍晚暖光似从左侧来，以橙与柔金勾出屋顶和小路，石墙和屋面则保持较冷紫灰。海面为斜向小路提供安静水平平衡。没有可见人物或可读文字。整体构图由纹理前景小路导向石屋与远水，以浓密可触的色彩平衡明亮海岸空气。
style_prompt_en: A broken-color oil-painted surface uses small overlapping strokes and fine stippling instead of smooth blends. Turquoise, cyan, emerald, olive, violet gray, ochre, and warm coral vibrate in adjacent patches. A diagonal band of textured marks leads from the foreground into a compact middle-distance mass, while a broad airy upper field opens the frame. Late warm side light adds salmon and gold edges against cooler blue-green shadows. Contours are readable but granular, built from many short marks rather than continuous lines. A quiet horizontal strip counterbalances the diagonal movement. The finish is luminous, tactile, and breezy, with color relationships carrying much of the spatial depth.
style_prompt_zh: 破碎色彩的油画表面使用小型重叠笔触与细点笔，而非平滑混色。青绿、浅青、祖母绿、橄榄、紫灰、赭色和暖珊瑚色在相邻斑块中振动。一条有纹理的斜向色带从前景引向中景紧凑体量，宽阔通透的上方色域打开画框。晚时暖侧光在较冷蓝绿阴影前增添鲑粉与金色边沿。轮廓可辨却有颗粒，由许多短笔而非连续线组成。一条安静水平带平衡斜向动势。成品明亮、有触感且轻快，色彩关系承担大部分空间纵深。
theme_en: A stone cottage and winding path on a sunlit coastal headland
theme_zh: 阳光海岬上石屋与弯曲小路
name: Henry Moret
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
